description: A 13 March Al-Jarida retrospective says electricity-ministry staff held five sit-ins at the ministry during February. It does not give the dates, identify whether the 14 February allowance sit-in is one of those five, estimate attendance at any single gathering, or establish whether each was a public gathering. Do not convert the series into one event or infer that the five investigated employees represent crowd size.
required_followup: Search only if a genuinely new permitted source can provide individual dates, crowd size and public venue. Until then keep the 14 February event's threshold pending and do not add/merge actions based solely on this retrospective.
